parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be disabled

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: The action to be taken on the interface, in this case, 'disable'

set interfaces.explanation: The command `set interfaces` in Junos is used to configure or define network interface settings such as IP addresses, VLANs, and other interface-specific parameters.

interface unit unit_number family family.explanation: Configures a VLAN membership for a specific interface unit under the Ethernet switching family.

parameters.name: unit_number
parameters.explanation: The logical unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: family_type
parameters.explanation: The protocol family type, in this case, 'ethernet-switching'.

parameters.name: vlan_id
parameters.explanation: The VLAN ID to which the interface unit is to be assigned.
